messages:
mia-partnerships: Heads-up: thinking about a short pilot for a 'Marketplace Onramp Credit' focused on cloud marketplace listings + SI co-sells. Objective: fast PoC -> committed SKU. Need checks on metering, renewal gating, and seller incentives.

aj-sales: Agree. Sales want clear milestones (30/60/90d) and a simple commission rule so reps don't game credits.

leo-ops: Ops note: metering must be deterministic. Recommend a single synthetic meter 'redwood_cu' for the pilot and webhook verification. Otherwise reconciliation gets messy.

claire-legal: Legal flags: credits expire at 180d, renewal auto-opts only if customer reached >=65% of committed tier in final 90d, and include audit rights. Will draft short clause.

mktplace-bot: Draft stub created: https://marketplace.internal/redwood/drafts/onramp-credit-pilot

tess-finance: Quick back-of-envelope: with $10k avg credit and 20% conversion we break even in ~10 months. Recommend pilot cap $100k total credits and per-account cap $25k.

eng-marketplace: We can add 'onramp_credit_v1' offer type and wire a reconciliation lambda. ETA listing + basic webhook ~7 business days. Need product to confirm milestone thresholds.

mia-partnerships: Action items: 1) @eng-marketplace create draft listing (ETA Fri), 2) @claire-legal draft clause (ETA Tue), 3) @tess-finance run cohort sims + cap (ETA Tue), 4) @aj-sales prepare seller 1-pager + commission guidance (ETA Wed), 5) @leo-ops build webhook spec (ETA Wed). Plan pilot with 2 SI partners after signoffs.

aj-sales: I'll target our top SI reps for feedback.

mia-partnerships: Thanks team — will compile artifacts into a single playbook once items are in. :sparkles:
